hudBackground.role: The actual HudView.BuildEmberRestPanel background sprite, per ui-lane's confirmed contract (2026-08-08 relay): panel is 620x420 (aspect 1.4762), so the sprite is cropped/composited to exactly 1024x694 (same aspect) instead of the sceneCutscene image's 1536:1024 (1.5) ratio.
hudBackground.derivedFrom: Assets/Resources/Scenes/scene-ember-rest.png (the already-shipped 1024x683 version) — NOT regenerated, per instruction ("재생성 불요").
transform: Uniform LANCZOS upscale by height (683 -> 694, ~1.6%) then width center-crop 1040 -> 1024.

Center-to-bottom flatten: alpha-blended fade to the panel's own backdrop color (Color(0.02,0.05,0.06) from HudView.BuildEmberRestPanel's existing solid Image) starting at 40% down the frame, reaching full flat by 80% down, eased with an x^1.6 curve, plus a 0.6px Gaussian blur to soften the seam. This keeps the archway/glyph motif visible in the top ~40% as atmospheric framing while the lower ~60% (where the 3 offer cards at y~-88..-216 and the 2 buttons at y~18..110 sit, all measured from HudView.cs BuildEmberRestPanel offsets) reads as clean, low-contrast backdrop for UI legibility, per ui-lane's "중앙~하단은 평탄하게" requirement.
Implemented as a one-off script (not added to a reusable tool — this is a single derived asset, unlike the terrain-fx sheets which needed a repeatable generator for 3 themes).
hudBackground.qualityCheck: Visually reviewed (Read tool image preview) before shipping: top-40% archway/glyph detail intact, bottom-60% smoothly flat and dark, no visible hard seam.

twoAssetDecision: Both files are intentionally kept, not a duplicate: scene-ember-rest.png is the cutscene-family master (full composition, 1536:1024-derived aspect, CutsceneView convention/location) and ui-ember-rest-bg.png is the actual HUD-panel-fitted derivative (1024x694, flattened center-bottom) that Assets/Scripts/View/HudView.cs's BuildEmberRestPanel needs. Deleting either would either break the Scenes/ convention slot or leave ui-lane without an asset that actually fits its panel aspect ratio and legibility requirement.
